g.title: enroll
g.text: /enroll — the only student route that WRITES
institution-scoped: no course, no semester in the path.
The student PASTES a public key; no private material is

g.title: faq
g.text: no auth, no server call, no account. Copy lives in
faq-content.ts; per-question anchors are published URLs

g.text: generate session keypair, bind it to the
manifest sig, and carry the FULL signed

g.title: sig
g.text: gated by the signed capture policy

g.title: push
g.text: git push — the SECOND way work leaves the machine
There is no submit moment: .provenance/ IS the submission,
no seal step ever runs, and the ROLLING seal is its only seal.
Per-session filenames keep a shared directory add-only
a rolling seal per session, rewritten after checkpoints
(at most a minute apart, never dropped) and shortly
after every save — so what is committed is a fresh seal

g.title: local
g.text: the same analysis-core runs in the
a monorepo zip offers a scope choice
a clone, zipped. Ingest declares the batch
a repo and fans it out per assignment scope

g.title: cross
g.text: Compared PER ASSIGNMENT, and never across two
bundles of one git-shared scope — proved by a shared
OBSERVED COMMIT or a shared SIGNED SESSION;
the semester's set is still replaced atomically

g.title: exp
g.text: /local only — the Export tab is a v3.1 stub

g.title: compose
g.text: IN THE BROWSER. The course private key is read
inside the sign handler and dropped on return —
never state, never a request, never storage.
every session after this is offline
